dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: Welcome, champion of the Tour of the Return of the Sacred Flame, you have earned our respect.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it not called the Ayar Heroes' Cup?

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: Well, you know how it is, people have real names and nicknames, and so do competitions. The Ayar Heroes' Cup is its official name, and the Tour is its nickname — Ipacura likes to call it that.

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: Ipacura's parents took part in the Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame alongside us. Unfortunately, they fell in battle during the last Abyss invasion.

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: That's why Ipacura likes to call this contest the Tour of the Return of the Sacred Flame.

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: You might have guessed by now, but his full name is Ipacura Ayar.

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: Before his parents passed, they entrusted Ipacura to us. That's why we set up this contest — we like to say it was to give him a happy summer... but the truth is...

dialogues.speaker: Nahuatlalli
dialogues.text: One day, he'll become a hero just like his parents. Isn't that right?
